answer: Vouching puts a sponsor's locked capital at risk: 200 units per newcomer, held 20 epochs, assigned to one identity, so 1,000 fakes need 200,000 units and splitting one lock leaves each clone below 200. Approvers from three invite subtrees sign after checking a terrace ledger whose steps hold one vouch each in lock-time order; a lock hash on two steps proves reuse. Each entry carries a lotus hash of sponsor, newcomer and lock, binding the vouch to one pair. Release crosses a timber gate returning 50 units per epoch after the challenge window closes, and a proven fake or reuse slashes the 200.
